topic: Advanced Use of Function Overloading and Reference Binding in C++
explanation: This concept involves leveraging C++'s function overloading and reference binding mechanisms to operate on class hierarchies through base class references. It, 'const Bear&') allows functions to work polymorphically with derived class objects (e.g., 'Panda'), enabling flexible and type-safe code that interacts with complex class hierarchies.
